body_markdown:
*New membership community brings together wellness, connection, and entertainment; Next event set for Nov. 6-8 during Life Time Phoenix Half Marathon & 10K weekend*

NEW YORK and CHANHASSEN, Minn.


, Sept. 16, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Life Time](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776097-1&h=741039328&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4759837-1%26h%3D3281970074%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.lifetime.life%252F%26a%3DLife%2BTime&a=Life+Time) (NYSE: LTH), officially debuted[Life Time Social](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776097-1&h=3227864712&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4759837-1%26h%3D3778969739%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.lifetime.life%252Fltsocial.html%26a%3DLife%2BTime%2BSocial%2B&a=Life+Time+Social) (LT Social), its new, private membership community on September 12 and 13 at Life Time Sky in New York City. Today, the Company launched its member applications for those on the waitlist.


"The response to LT Social at Life Time Sky in New York reinforced just how much demand for connection exists."


The two-day launch was timed to coincide with one of the city's most anticipated weekends in sports, fashion and culture. The next LT Social will take place Nov. 6-8 at Life Time Biltmore as the 51st running of the[Life Time Phoenix Half Marathon and 10K](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776097-1&h=3812667142&u=https%3A%2F%2Fphoenix10k.com%2F&a=Life+Time+Phoenix+Half+Marathon+and+10K) , presented by JP MorganChase.


LT Social extends the healthy way of life that Life Time members already share inside the Company's nearly 200 athletic country clubs. With events set around destination weekends and cultural events, LT Social creates new opportunities for people to meet, connect and spend time together with nightlife, wellness and recovery at the forefront.


The inaugural launch weekend brought together nearly 1,000 invited guests and members for two days of curated experiences. It kicked off on Saturday night on Life Time's Sky Deck overlooking the Manhattan skyline, where guests were welcomed with a red-carpet arrival, while celebrity DJ's Brendan Fallis, Mahogany and Alexandra Richards as well as aerialists, violinists entertained the crowd. A curated menu of food and specialty cocktails flowed throughout the night with notable guests including James Bok, Dale Moss, Carolyn Silva, Jimmy Sotos, Jenna Litner and others joining the exclusive celebration.


Sunday was built around wellness, recovery and connection with group classes, massages, stretch sessions and experiences from Life Time, LifeSpa, TechnoGym, Hyperice, Forte, Elmhurst Coffee Bar and LTH. As the rain lifted, the Clubhouse came to life on the Sky Deck with an afternoon pool party featuring DJ Ruby J and Five Eleven, decadent food and creative cocktails from LifeCafe and Forte frozen treats. Guests also built their own gift bag from Khiel's, UNRL, Peepers, Archie's, and Life Time.


"The need for genuine human connection has never been greater and the response we saw in New York reinforced just how much this demand exists," said Michelle Duffy, Vice President of Events at Life Time. "People traveled from California, Colorado, Illinois, Massachusetts, Florida and beyond to experience the debut of LT Social and it was a thrill to see how naturally connections formed throughout the weekend. The energy, enthusiasm and stories exceeded our expectations, and we can't wait for all that's to come with Phoenix on the horizon in early November."


Following the New York debut and upcoming Phoenix event, LT Social will host experiences in Life Time destinations nationwide, including Miami, Chicago, Minneapolis, Dallas, Denver Southern California and more.


Those interested in learning more and becoming a part of LT Social can join the LT Social[waitlist](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776097-1&h=346850587&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lifetime.life%2Fltsocial%2Finquire.html&a=waitlist) through the Life Time app for a membership application. Follow along on Instagram at[@LifeTime.Social](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776097-1&h=2249127040&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Flifetime.social%2F&a=%40LifeTime.Social) .


For more information about Life Time, visit the[Life Time Newsroom](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776097-1&h=2491310529&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnews.lifetime.life%2F&a=Life+Time+Newsroom) , or[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776097-1&h=1404183039&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4319435-1%26h%3D3140085575%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.linkedin.com%252Fcompany%252Flifetimeinc%252Fposts%252F%253FfeedView%253Dall%26a%3DLinkedIn&a=LinkedIn) or at[Facebook](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776097-1&h=268628123&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4319435-1%26h%3D2371622602%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.facebook.com%252FLifeTime.Life%26a%3DFacebook&a=Facebook) and[Instagram](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4776097-1&h=2546162553&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4319435-1%26h%3D80787269%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.instagram.com%252Flifetime.life%252F%26a%3DInstagram&a=Instagram) .


**About Life Time** Life Time (NYSE: LTH) empowers people to live healthy, happy lives through its more than 195 athletic country clubs across the U.S. and Canada, the complimentary and comprehensive Life Time app featuring its L•AI•C™ AI-powered health companion, and more than 30 iconic athletic events. Serving people ages 90 days to 90+ years, the Life Time ecosystem uniquely delivers healthy living, healthy aging, and healthy entertainment experiences, a range of unique healthy way of life programs, highly trusted LTH nutritional supplements and more. Recognized as a Great Place to Work®, the company is committed to upholding an exceptional culture for its more than 50,000 team members.


FAQ:
**What is LT Social?** LT Social is a new private membership community from Life Time for members and designed to create more opportunities to meet, connect and spend time together beyond their home club and beyond the workout.


**Who is LT Social for?** LT Social was created for couples, singles and friends who want to meet others interested in a fit and active lifestyle.


**Where will LT Social experiences take place?** Experiences will take place at select Life Time destinations across the country, including New York, Miami, Chicago, Minneapolis, Dallas, Denver, Phoenix, Southern California and other markets.


**What happens after I join the waitlist?** Join the LT Social waitlist through the Life Time app. Membership applications will open in mid-September in the order the waitlist was established. Once accepted, members will begin receiving updates on upcoming LT Social events and experiences.


**How do I learn more?** Members and nonmembers can join the LT Social waitlist through the Life Time app to receive updates on membership opportunities, upcoming events and future announcements.
